Dāṭhanāga_Rājaguru
of Ratnapura in Tambadīparaṭṭha in Burma; preceptor of Sirinandadhammarāja Pavarādhipatirāja (1648 A. D.). [Page002-a.
--C. Niruttisāramañjūṣā on the Mukhamattadīpani of Vimala Buddha Thera. Colombo D. I. 2112.
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma p. 55.

Dāṭhādhātuvaṃsa
history of Tooth relic; composed in C. 1200 A. D.; one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D. See Malalasekhara, Pāli Lit. of Ceylon p. 66.
Fausboll 140. 141.
--C. Ṭīkā. Fausboll 142.

Dāṭhāvaṃsa
Bud. Pāli. mahākāvya. on the Tooth relic. Composed during the reign of Līlāvatī (c. 1200 A. D.). by Dhammakitti; based on a. earlier work Daladāvam3sa. See Malalasekhara, Pāli Lit. of Ceylon p.. 207-09.
Colombo p.. 50. 53. IO. Pāli p. 118 (no. 95).
Pt.. (1) in Sinhalese script. Eng. transl. London, 1874. (2) in Roman script. JPTS. 1884. p.. 109-51. (3) with Eng. transl. by B. C. Law. Punjab Skt. Ser. 7. 1925.
French transl. AMG. 7. (1884) p.. 307-96.
